referents.why: third masculine singular 'he had appointed' (qatal) in the relative clause on 'the frogs': the one who brought the frogs against Pharaoh is the LORD, named in this verse (w12).

links.why: cl0 ('went out') is the earlier event and cl1 ('cried out') the later. This link runs backward.
wayyiqtol cl1 continues the narrative line from cl0: Moses and Aaron leave Pharaoh, and then Moses cries out.
'which he had appointed for Pharaoh' is a relative clause inside the noun phrase 'the frogs', which is the object in cl1.
links.category: relative clause in a noun phrase

cant_tell.what: whether 'Moses cried out to the LORD' (cl1) fulfils the command 'pray to Yahweh' (Exo.8.4#cl2)
cant_tell.why: the fulfilment rule needs a pro-form report (asah plus ken). This report has none, so no fulfils link is added; the sense supports it.
